‘RUIN’ is coded as ‘3719’

‘RUNG’ is coded as ‘7916’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e121794406f7b9740faee7973d4cbd30d644adc71dcb6401edf11525d732f66.png]
